scope:
Compare coordinator loading under fixed geometry and alternating binaries.

Only polls health; no inference or worker-startup performance is measured.
The caller owns stopping/restoring any existing coordinator.
warmup: one before launch excluded from summaries

interpretation: Paired loading reduces physical reads and takes about one second less in high-I/O observations. Cache state is uncontrolled: no universal speedup or final startup qualification claim. Read-call volume remains about 246.6 GB; this change improves page reuse, not logical read volume.
correctness: TP2 B12x reference passes bitwise FP32 ranks and BF16 peer sums for both independent lanes at rows 16/1/3/16/1; all seven startup launches preserve the exact 14M-token KV allocation.
